E-Plans  For non-shared firms, and individual E-Plans have not been created, system shall display the status as ‘Pending Individual E-Plan’.  For shared firms, agency shall create their respective individual E-Plans.

8.3.2 The Coordinating Agency shall work with the other requesting agencies and the firm to come out with the Combined E-Plan to fulfil the requirement for a WOG’s approach with the firm providing essential services.  System shall display the status as ‘Completed’ when individual and/or combined E-Plans are created.  System shall remind CRO(Undertaking) and Controller Undertakings Office three months before the due date of the E-Plan. System shall continue to send monthly reminders if the E-Plan information is still not updated after one year from the date of approval of allocation of the firm. title: Manage Requisition Plans
acceptance_criteria: 8.4.1 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to create, update, view and delete Undertaking Requisition Plan.

8.4.2 System shall have various plan types and CRO(Undertaking) must select ‘Training’, ‘Exercise (Others)’, ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ or ‘Operation’ when creating an Undertaking Requisition plan. a. ‘Exercise (Others)’ – Peacetime exercise that is carried out without invoking RORA and it is through arrangement with the firm such as contractual arrangement. There is no need to create an Undertaking Requisition Plan in CRIPS. CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to update the exercise completion details in CRIPS.
8.4.3 b. ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ – CRA will need to obtain Minister for Defence’s approval to invoke RORA for a specific time period for the exercise.

8.4.4 CRO(Undertaking) shall create an undertaking requisition plan as the requisition process shall be executed using CRIPS. The services required can be imported and selected from the schedule of services created prior. c. If the selected Requisition Plan type is ‘Training’, ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ or ‘Operation’ type, Chief Controller Office shall receive an email notification to approve the undertaking requisition plan.

title: Manage Requisition
acceptance_criteria: 8.5.1 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to update and view existing Undertakings Requisition Plans.

8.5.2 System shall trigger the appropriate workflow based on the type of requisition plan, a. ‘Exercise (Others)’ – CRO(Undertaking) shall only be required to update the basic details of the exercise. Upon the completion of the exercise, CRO(Undertaking) shall update the plan details and set to ‘Closed’ status. CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to cancel requisition plan that has not been closed. a. b. ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ – Chief Controller Office must approve the requisition plan before CRO(Undertaking) can execute the requisition process in CRIPS. Given that exercises are pre-planned, CRO(Undertaking) shall not be allowed to add new services or import from the E-Plan’s schedule of services after the requisition plan has been approved. ‘Operation’ – The workflow is similar to ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ and shall have flexibility. During the requisition phase, CRO(Undertaking) shall be allowed to include new services or import from schedule of services maintained in the E-Plan. c. d. e. ‘Training’ – The workflow is similar to ‘Exercise (invoke RORA)’ and shall have flexibility to include new schedule of services during the requisition phase. As this is for internal training, email notifications shall not be sent to the POC of the firms included in the requisition plan. Instead, they shall be sent to the CRO(Undertaking) who created the requisition plan. The compensation process is not applicable for training plans. Undertaking Requisition Plans shall have one of following statuses at any point in time, Planning – Upon the creation of the plan.  Pending Approval – When CRO(Undertaking) submit the plan to Chief Controller Office for approval.  Pending Requisition – After the plan is approved by Chief Controller Office but the requisition has not yet started. At this stage, Notice of Direction (NOD) is not printed and issued to the firm.  Requisition – This stage is where NOD Acknowledgement is received, and the actual requisition process has commenced.  TNOD Issued – When the Termination of NOD is issued with outstanding services.  Closed - Requisition Plan is completed with no further action required. Exercise (Others) Exercise (invoke RORA), Operation, Training Planning Planning Closed Pending Approval OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED) RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 Pending Requisition Requisition TNOD Issued Closed

8.5.3 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to import Schedule of Services that was maintained when creating individual/ combined E-Plans. If Schedule of Services was not maintained in E-Plans, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to create the Schedule of Services in the undertaking requisition plan. CRO(Undertaking) shall update the quantity of each service required for the requisition plan. For each Schedule of Services, CRO(Undertaking) shall select the fund objects (e.g. G/L account, Commitment Item, Fund Centre, Cost Centre, etc) and this is applicable only for MINDEF/SAF.
8.5.4 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to save the undertaking requisition plan as draft.

8.5.5 Upon finalising all the details in the requisition plan, CRO(Undertaking) shall submit the plan. Except for ‘Exercise (Others)’ requisition plan, an email notification shall be sent to inform Chief Controller Office of a plan pending his/her approval.
8.5.6 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to save the undertakings requisition plan as draft.

8.5.7 Upon finalising all the details in the requisition plan, CRO(Undertaking) shall submit the plan. Except for ‘Exercise (Others)’ requisition plan, an email notification shall be sent to inform Chief Controller Office of a plan pending his/her approval.
8.5.8 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to execute approved undertakings requisition plans.

8.5.9 DPCU00001. Specific only to requisition plan created with ‘Operation’ type, CRO(Undertaking) shall be allowed to add new services or import additional schedule of services. CRO(Undertaking) shall be allowed to generate a new DPCU after adding new services or import additional schedule of services.

8.5.10 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to perform service acceptance after the requisitioned services have been completed. CRO(Undertaking) shall only be allowed to perform service acceptance on the services tagged to the DPCUs. Partial acceptance of service shall be allowed so that progressive payment can be made to the firm. System shall show the balance quantity available for acceptance. System shall require CRO(Undertaking) to update the acceptance date (default to current system date) and attach supporting document when he/she performs the service acceptance. The compensation process shall be initiated upon service acceptance.
8.5.11 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to terminate DPCU and is required to enter the termination date of the DPCU. He/She shall be able to generate the TDPCU after terminating the DPCU.

title: Manage Compensation
acceptance_criteria: 8.6.1 System shall compute the compensation amount payable to firms based on rates updated in the undertakings requisition plan.
8.6.2 System shall retrieve the firm’s GST registration number (e.g. via API with IRAS Marketplace). CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to select the applicable GST rate, e.g. 0%, 9%.

8.6.3 System shall support progressive compensation when the requisition is for a prolonged duration of more than one month and allow progressive compensation upon acceptance of services (partial or full).

8.6.4 For compensation for Undertakings Requisition Plan, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to view compensations and appeals of the selected requisition plan and select the desired status, a. ‘All’ – It shall display all compensations and appeals. b. ‘Verification’ – It shall display compensations that are pending CRIC Office’s verification. c. ‘Review Compensation’ – It shall display compensations rejected by CRIC Office and requires CRO(Undertaking) to follow-up. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

8.6.5 d. ‘Review Payment Request’ – It shall display compensations rejected by Approving Officer(Undertaking). e. ‘Approved’ – It shall display verified compensation and approved payment requests. f. ‘Appeal’ – It shall display all appeals created in the system. g. ‘Owner’s Response’ – It shall display appeals reviewed by Controller CRIC.
8.6.6 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to download documents attached to undertaking requisition plans.
8.6.7 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to resubmit for verification for cases previously rejected by Controller CRIC Office.
8.6.8 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to resubmit for approval for cases rejected by Approving Officer(Undertaking) previously.
8.6.9 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to create appeals upon receiving such requests from the firm. He/She shall be able to view appeals created by his/her agency.
8.6.10 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to update the firm’s response wrt Appeal and Decision by Controller CRIC.

8.6.11 b. For Undertakings Requisition Plans initiated by Homefront users, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to export/download the compensation details for payment processing via their respective financial systems.
8.6.12 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to upload the payment details (e.g. payment date, payment reference number, payment amount, etc) to close the record in the system.

title: Review Payment Instruction
acceptance_criteria: 8.7.1 System shall restrict this function to CRO(Undertaking) from MINDEF/SAF. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
8.7.2 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to re-submit compensation payment instructions previously rejected by MINDEF/SAF payment system.

title: Export Homefront Payment
acceptance_criteria: 8.8.1 System shall restrict this function to CRO(Undertaking) from Homefront Agencies.

8.8.2 For Undertakings Requisition Plans initiated by Homefront users, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to export/download the compensation payment details so that he/she can submit to his/her agency’s finance department to process the payments to the firms. CRO(Undertaking) shall only be able to export/download compensation records that have been verified by CRIC Officer in CRIPS.

8.8.3 CRO(Undertaking) shall be allowed to upload the payment details (e.g. AGD payment date, payment reference number, payment amount, etc) to close the record in CRIPS. He/She shall be able to download the template, fill in the additional details and upload the information in CRIPS.

title: Reports
acceptance_criteria: 8.9.1 CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to generate a. Undertakings Requirement Approval Status Report. This report gives an overview of the status of requests for companies/firms by the requesting agency. The report also has information such as the approval dates by the various stakeholders given that each request is routed through multiple agencies. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency, Submission From Dates and Current Status. b. Essential Firms (by Agency) Report. This report generates the list of firms by Requesting Agencies. When generating the report, users shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency and Allocated From Dates. c. Essential Firms (by Company) Report. This report generates the list of firms by company/firm. The report shall show if the Company is ‘Individual’ or ‘Shared’, and if it is ‘Shared’, it shall show the list of agencies that have registered the company. When generating the report, users shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Coordinating Agency and the Allocated from dates. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

8.9.2 d. Undertakings Readiness (by Agency) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by Requesting Agencies. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and the range of the approval dates. e. Undertakings Readiness (by Company) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by company/firm. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and the range of the approval dates. f. Essential Firm Security Clearance Status Report. This report generates the status of security clearance of companies. When generating the report, users shall be able to select the clearance status (e.g. all status, submitted, approved, pending, rejected). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and Security Clearance. g. Essential Firm Security Re-Clearance Report. This report generates the list of companies that are subjected to security re-clearance. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm, Security Expiry Date, Re-clearance status. h. Schedule of Service Report. This report generates a listing of the Schedule of Service of the firms. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency and Essential Firm. i. Outstanding Service Acceptance. This report generated the list of outstanding service acceptance after TDPCUs have been served. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency and Essential Firm. j. Undertakings Requisition Compensation Report. This report generates compensation report for undertakings requisition plan. It shall allow users to select the Requisition Plan name, Compensation Status, etc. k. Undertakings Requisition Payment Report (Homefront). This report generates payment report for undertakings requisition plan; consists of Homefront payments that go through manual payment. It shall allow users to select the Requisition Plan name, etc. l. Undertakings Requisition Payment Report (MINDEF/SAF). This report generates payment report for undertakings requisition plan; consists of MINDEF/SAF payment processed by DFO’s Payment Service Hub (PSH) or Enterprise System (ES). It shall allow users to select the Requisition plan name, etc. CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to export/download the reports.

title: Manage Firms Information
acceptance_criteria: 9.2.1 System shall have flexibility such that Controller Undertakings Office can manage the firm’s information without having to de-register and re-register the firm.

9.2.2 For undertakings registered by my agency, system shall allow Controller Undertakings Office to edit and view information of the company, e.g. a. The company’s Point of Contact b. Internal comments (any notes about the company)
9.2.3 For allocated or approved firms, Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to update selected information, e.g. addresses, contact details, etc.

9.2.4 When displaying the firm’s name on screen or in generated reports, system shall use the firm’s UEN to retrieve the most updated company name based on ACRA data that is also stored in CRIPS. SSIC of the company shall also be displayed.

9.2.5 For undertakings registered by an agency, system shall allow the Controller Undertakings Office of that particular agency to de-register companies that have been allocated by Lead Agency or have been approved by Controller Undertakings. An email notification shall be sent to Controller Undertakings to inform of the de- registration request pending his/her action. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
9.2.6 System shall send an email notification to Controller Undertakings Office to inform him/her that Controller Undertakings has deallocated the firm.

9.2.7 Controller Undertakings Office shall be able to re-submit security clearance should the approved EF has senior management changes. The re-submission shall be routed to MHA Office for processing, including an email notification to inform MHA Office that there are re-submission requests and require their actions.

title: Manage Allocations
acceptance_criteria: 9.3.1 System shall list Controller Undertakings as one of the Lead Agencies for selection under the Lead Agency field.
9.3.2 Upon a Requesting Agency’s submission of a request to register a firm, system shall send an email notification to the Lead Agency for allocation.

9.3.3 Lead Agency shall be able to allocate and reject agency’s requests routed to him/her. Lead Agency shall be able to allocate a company to the request if no preferred company is not indicated in the request. If Lead Agency rejects the request, system shall prompt him/her to enter the reason for rejecting the request.
9.3.4 System shall enable Lead Agency to process the request individually. He/She shall also be able to select multi requests to allocate/reject.
9.3.5 After allocation, if there is more than one agency that requires the firm, system shall update it from ‘Individual’ to ‘Shared’ firm.

9.3.6 System shall enable Lead Agency to display all undertaking requirements pending his/her action, a. ‘All’ – This shall be the default selection, and display all Undertaking requirements regardless of their status. b. ‘Requirement’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with the ‘Review Requirement’ status, i.e. requirements rejected from Lead Agency due to various reasons (e.g. incomplete information). c. ‘Allocation’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with ‘Pending Allocation’, ‘Pending De-Allocation’ or ‘Rejected Security Clearance’ status. d. ‘Company Details’ – Display all requirements that are pending CRO(Undertakings)’s action to fill in the allocated company details for submission of security clearance (template per MHA’s requirements). e. ‘Clearance’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with ‘Pending Security Clearance’ status, i.e. requirements with company details submitted.
